item.text: The MCP BRCA object already has the requested top 20 by `MutatedSamples`; the provided gene list matches that set. I’m standardizing the clinical fields in a new RDS, computing retention against those 20 genes, and writing the TSV/TXT audit files under this run’s `outputs`.

/bin/zsh -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(maftools)
  library(data.table)
})
base_rds <- \"maftools_validation_data/LLM_Stage2_validation/LLM_validation_input_file/BRCA.rds\"
outdir <- \"outputs\"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
selected_genes <- c(\"PIK3CA\", \"TP53\", \"TTN\", \"CDH1\", \"GATA3\", \"MUC16\", \"KMT2C\", \"MAP3K1\", \"FLG\", \"RYR2\", \"HMCN1\", \"SYNE1\", \"USH2A\", \"PTEN\", \"SPTA1\", \"NEB\", \"ZFHX4\", \"NCOR1\", \"DMD\", \"OBSCN\")
stage_order <- c(\"Stage I\", \"Stage IA\", \"Stage IB\", \"Stage II\", \"Stage IIA\", \"Stage IIB\", \"Stage III\", \"Stage IIIA\", \"Stage IIIB\", \"Stage IIIC\", \"Stage IV\", \"Stage X\", \"[Not Available]\")
maf <- readRDS(base_rds)
# Standardize clinical annotations in the MAF object.
clin <- as.data.table(maf@clinical.data)
if ("'!"Tumor_Sample_Barcode" %in% names(clin)) stop("clinical.data missing Tumor_Sample_Barcode")
if (!"Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min" %in% names(clin)) {
  clin[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min := substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12)]
}
clean_stage <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NA" | x == "<NA>" | x == "[Not Applicable]" | x == "[Unknown]"] <- "[Not Available]"
  x[!(x %in% stage_order)] <- "[Not Available]"
  x
}
clean_gender <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NA" | x == "<NA>" | x == "[Not Applicable]" | x == "[Unknown]"] <- "[Not Available]"
  x
}
if ("CDR_ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage" %in% names(clin)) {
  clin[, Tumor_Stage := clean_stage(CDR_ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage)]
} else if ("pathologic_stage" %in% names(clin)) {
  clin[, Tumor_Stage := clean_stage(pathologic_stage)]
} else {
  clin[, Tumor_Stage := "[Not Available]"]
}
if ("CDR_gender" %in% names(clin)) {
  clin[, Gender := clean_gender(CDR_gender)]
} else if ("gender" %in% names(clin)) {
  clin[, Gender := clean_gender(gender)]
} else {
  clin[, Gender := "[Not Available]"]
}
setcolorder(clin, c("Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Tumor_Stage", "Gender", setdiff(names(clin), c("Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Tumor_Stage", "Gender"))))
maf@clinical.data <- clin
std_rds <- file.path(outdir, "tcga_brca_standardized.rds")
saveRDS(maf, std_rds)
# Top 20 summary in requested gene order; selected set comes from MutatedSamples top 20.
gs <- as.data.table(maf@gene.summary)
top20_by_count <- gs[order(-MutatedSamples, match(Hugo_Symbol, selected_genes), Hugo_Symbol)][1:20]
if (!setequal(top20_by_count$Hugo_Symbol, selected_genes)) {
  warning("Provided selected_genes does not exactly match top20_by_count")
}
top20 <- gs[match(selected_genes, Hugo_Symbol)]
top20[, Rank := seq_len(.N)]
setcolorder(top20, c("Rank", setdiff(names(top20), "Rank")))
fwrite(top20, file.path(outdir, "top20_gene_summary.tsv"), sep="'"\\t\", na=\"NA\")
# Mutation burden over all non-silent variants in the MAF object, preserving sample burden even after filtering top genes.
burden <- as.data.table(maf@variants.per.sample)
setnames(burden, c(\"Tumor_Sample_Barcode\", \"Variants\"), c(\"Tumor_Sample_Barcode\", \"Mutation_Burden\"), skip_absent=TRUE)
burden[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
all_samples <- sort(unique(as.character(maf@data"'$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)))
full_burden <- data.table(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = all_samples)
full_burden <- merge(full_burden, burden, by="Tumor_Sample_Barcode", all.x=TRUE)
full_burden[is.na(Mutation_Burden), Mutation_Burden := 0L]
mut_top <- unique(as.character(maf@data[Hugo_Symbol %in% selected_genes, Tumor_Sample_Barcode]))
removed <- setdiff(all_samples, mut_top)
clin_map <- unique(clin[, .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min, Tumor_Stage, Gender)])
full_burden[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min := substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12)]
retained <- full_burden[Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% mut_top]
retained <- merge(retained, clin_map, by="Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min", all.x=TRUE)
retained[is.na(Tumor_Stage) | !(Tumor_Stage %in% stage_order), Tumor_Stage := "[Not Available]"]
retained[is.na(Gender) | Gender == "", Gender := "[Not Available]"]
retained[, Tumor_Stage := factor(Tumor_Stage, levels=stage_order, ordered=TRUE)]
setorder(retained, Tumor_Stage, -Mutation_Burden, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
retained[, Sample_Order := seq_len(.N)]
retained_out <- retained[, .(Sample_Order, Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min, Tumor_Stage=as.character(Tumor_Stage), Gender, Mutation_Burden)]
fwrite(retained_out, file.path(outdir, "sample_order_with_mutation_burden.tsv"), sep="'"\\t\", na=\"NA\")
# Clinical annotation used for retained samples in final order.
fwrite(retained_out[, .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min, Tumor_Stage, Gender)], file.path(outdir, \"clinical_annotation_used.tsv\"), sep=\"\\t\", na=\"NA\")
writeLines(removed, file.path(outdir, \"removed_nonmutated_samples.txt\"))
# Also write full clinical data exported via MCP subset names for traceability.
fwrite(clin[, .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode_min, Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Tumor_Stage, Gender)], file.path(outdir, \"clinical_annotation_all_standardized.tsv\"), sep=\"\\t\", na=\"NA\")
# Persist sample order vector for MCP plot_oncoplot.
writeLines(retained_out"'$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, file.path(outdir, "sample_order.txt"))
counts <- retained_out[, .N, by=Tumor_Stage]
counts[, Tumor_Stage := factor(Tumor_Stage, levels=stage_order, ordered=TRUE)]
setorder(counts, Tumor_Stage)
fwrite(counts, file.path(outdir, "retained_stage_counts.tsv"), sep="'"\\t\", na=\"NA\")
cat(\"standardized_rds=\", normalizePath(std_rds), \"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"top20=\", paste(selected_genes, collapse=\", \"), \"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"retained=\", nrow(retained_out), \"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"removed=\", length(removed), \"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"stage_counts\\n\")
print(counts)
RS"

setorder(clin, Sample_Order)
